name: nuts_level
description: NUTS 2024 level of both regions in the pair: nuts1, nuts2 or nuts3
observations: Derived from the source file name (nuts1_2024.csv, nuts2_2024.csv, nuts3_2024.csv). Pairs never mix levels. scaled_sci is rescaled separately within each level

name: user_country_id
description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the user's country
observations: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code as published by Meta. Kosovo is coded XK, a user-assigned code outside ISO 3166-1. Namibia is coded NA

name: friend_country_id
description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the friend's country
observations: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code as published by Meta. Kosovo is coded XK, a user-assigned code outside ISO 3166-1. Namibia is coded NA

name: user_region_id
description: Identifier of the user's NUTS 2024 region
observations: Eurostat NUTS 2024 code (e.g. FRC, EL5). Codes for EU candidate and EFTA countries follow the NUTS 2024 statistical regions. Data Basis has no NUTS directory yet

name: friend_region_id
description: Identifier of the friend's NUTS 2024 region
observations: Eurostat NUTS 2024 code (e.g. FRC, EL5). Codes for EU candidate and EFTA countries follow the NUTS 2024 statistical regions. Data Basis has no NUTS directory yet

name: scaled_sci
description: Scaled Social Connectedness Index between the user region and the friend region, proportional to the probability that a Facebook user in the first is friends with a Facebook user in the second
observations: Dimensionless relative index: SCI(i,j) = friendships(i,j) / (users(i) x users(j)), rescaled by Meta to lie between 1 and 1,000,000,000 within each source file. Ratios are comparable within a table (and within a level), not across tables. Symmetric: SCI(i,j) = SCI(j,i)
